data_source: Binance Vision USD-M 1-minute klines, bookDepth, and 5-minute metrics. Because liquidationSnapshot files are absent on Binance Vision for 2024-2026 (HTTP 404), liquidation intensity is measured by the pre-specified open-interest contraction proxy: LIQ_{s,h} = sum_{m in h} max(0, -Delta log OI_{s,m}) * 1[|Delta log p_{s,m}| > med_s(|Delta log p|)] * 1e4 bp
inference: 2,000 date-block bootstrap draws; Holm adjustment at 0.05 across the two primaries
primary_1: Six-hour C3_hat forecasts next-hour liquidation intensity LIQ_{s,h+1} out of sample on the 2025-2026 test dates beyond the Part 9 volatility and four-impact-control baseline (Delta R^2 > 0, one-sided Clark-West p < 0.025, 2,000-draw date-block bootstrap 95% CI above 0)
primary_2: Adding realized liquidation intensity LIQ_{s,h+1} to the next-hour maximum adverse excursion (MAE_{s,h+1}) forecast removes at least half (>= 50%) of C3_hat out-of-sample forecasting gain Delta R^2
study: Paper 2 Part 22: Pre-registered liquidation mechanism test on untouched 22nd-of-month dates
